m: plava mf(ā)n. swimming, floating, ŚāṅkhGṛ.; Suśr.
sloping towards, inclined, Hariv.; Var.; Hcat. (in astrol. applied to a constellation situated in the quarter ruled by its planetary regent, Var., Sch.)
plava m. n. (ifc. f(ā). ) a float, raft, boat, small ship, RV. &c. &c.
plava m. a kind of aquatic bird (= gātra-samplava, kāraṇḍava, jala-vāyasa, jala-kāka or jala-kukkuṭa, L.), VS. &c. &c.
a snare or basket of wicker-work for catching fish, L.
the 35th (or 9th) year in a cycle of Jupiter, VarBṛS.
plava m. swimming, bathing (ifc. f(ā). ), MBh.; R.; Kathās.
plava m. flooding, a flood, the swelling of a river, MBh.; MārkP.
the prolated utterance of a vowel (= pluti), L.
protraction of a sentence through 3 or more Ślokas (= kulaka), L.
sloping down or towards, proclivity, inclination, L.
N. of a Sāman (also with vasiṣṭhasya), ĀrṣBr.
jumping, leaping, plunging, going by leaps or plunges, R. (cf. comp. below)
plava n. Cyperus Rotundus or a species of fragrant grass, Suśr. [cf. Gk. πλόος for πλοϝος, πλοῖον]
a: plava a. [plu-ac] 1 Swimming, floating. 2 Jumping, leaping. 3 Ved. Superior, excellent. — vaḥ 1 Swimming, floating. 2 Flood, swelling of a river. 3 A jump, leap. 4 A raft, float, canoe, small boat; nāśayecca śanaiḥ paścātplavaṃ salilapūravat Pt. 2. 38; sarvaṃ jñānaplavenaiva vṛjinaṃ saṃtariṣyasi Bg. 4. 36; Ms. 4. 194; 11. 19; Ve. 3. 25. 5 A frog. 6 A monkey. 7 A declivity, slope. 8 An enemy. 9 A sheep. 10 A man of a low tribe; a Cāṇḍāla. 11 A net or snare for catching fish. 12 The fig-tree. 13 The Kāraṇḍava bird, a kind of duck. 14 Five or more stanzas syntactically connected. (= kulaka q. v.) 15 The prolated utterance of a vowel. 16 Returning, return. 17 Urging on, inciting. Comp. — gaḥ 1 a monkey; R. 12. 70. 2  a frog. 3 an aquatic bird, the diver. 4 the tree śirīṣa. 5 N. of the sun's charioteer. — (gā) the sign of the zodiac called Virgo. — gatiḥ a frog.
